Database._doc: Provider = sqlite | postgres. Tests use in-memory SQLite directly; the running app uses this. Per-environment, override ConnectionStrings:Default + Database:Provider via env (ConnectionStrings__Default / Database__Provider).

Notifications._doc: FilePath = dev notification log. Smtp = real outbound email (off by default — dev/test/sandbox use file + in-app + sandbox-capture). In real environments set Smtp:Enabled + Host/Port/Username/Password/Security via env, pointed at a relay (Azure Communication Services SMTP, SendGrid SMTP, …).
